INSERT INTO fly_trace (apply_id, uav_id, point_geo, altitude, speed, battery_remain, report_time, created_at) VALUES

mapper.select: SELECT trace_id, apply_id, uav_id, ST_AsText(point_geo) AS point_wkt, altitude AS alt, speed, battery_remain, report_time AS report_at, created_at FROM fly_trace WHERE apply_id = #{applyId} ORDER BY report_time ASC

SELECT trace_id, apply_id, uav_id, ST_AsText(point_geo) AS point_wkt, altitude AS alt, speed, battery_remain, report_time AS report_at, created_at FROM fly_trace WHERE uav_id = #{uavId} ORDER BY report_time DESC, trace_id DESC LIMIT 1
